title: The Riverside Chess Club Ladder
blurb: The Riverside Chess Club ladder is recalculated monthly and disputed continuously.

text.intro:
The Riverside Chess Club ladder is recalculated monthly and disputed continuously.
Five players are involved. Determine each player's placing, opening and clock.
- **Player**: Hannah, Birgitta, Olumide, Dermot and Casimir.
- **Placing** (listed from better to worse): first, second, third, fourth and fifth.
- **Favourite opening**: the Grunfeld, the Dutch Defence, the London System, the Bird's Opening and the Catalan.
- **Clock**: a hotel alarm clock, a wooden analog clock, a chipped BHB clock, no clock at all and a borrowed digital clock.
Every player has a different placing, opening and clock, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: The player who uses a hotel alarm clock favours the Grunfeld.
The player who favours the Dutch Defence and second are exactly two places apart in placing order.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The player who uses a chipped BHB clock is better than the player who favours the Dutch Defence in placing order. (b) The player who favours the London System places third.
The player who uses a wooden analog clock and first are exactly two places apart in placing order.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The player who uses a chipped BHB clock and second are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other. (b) The player who uses a chipped BHB clock and Olumide are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other.
One of the player who uses no clock at all and first sits at an odd-numbered placing and the other at an even-numbered placing.
Olumide falls somewhere between the player who favours the Dutch Defence and the player who favours the London System in placing order, matching neither.
The player who uses a wooden analog clock does not favour the Bird's Opening.
The player who favours the Bird's Opening and Birgitta are exactly two places apart in placing order.
The player who uses a wooden analog clock and Hannah are exactly two places apart in placing order.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The player who favours the Dutch Defence and Dermot are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other. (b) The player who favours the Bird's Opening is better than Casimir in placing order.
One of the player who uses a chipped BHB clock and the player who favours the Catalan sits at an odd-numbered placing and the other at an even-numbered placing.

The following two do NOT both hold; either one alone may hold, and so may neither: (a) The player who favours the Dutch Defence and Dermot are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other. (b) Dermot does not favour the Bird's Opening.
